message: DATA-06 candidate: parcel-derived positive element count arrayLength is passed as a byte count to malloc for typed arrays id, type, then the same count controls indexed stores. CheckReadLength establishes parcel availability, not output allocation width.

Confirm the out-of-bounds stores and concrete process impact in an isolated runtime.
